details:
We have developed a game inspired by the Artemis II mission, which combines 3D graphics with an immersive educational experience focused on space mission management. The game is divided into five stages: resource management, spacecraft construction, launch, lunar navigation, and the return to Earth. As a single-player experience, it places participants in various roles throughout the mission, challenging them to take control and make critical decisions at each phase. Players can choose from different difficulty levels: easy, intermediate, and hard.

Players are responsible for planning and managing key aspects of the mission, including spacecraft design, material selection, and budget allocation. Throughout the game, non-player characters (NPCs) provide guidance and support, helping players understand the consequences of their choices and overcome the challenges necessary to carry out a successful space mission.

One of the game’s most innovative features is its decision-making system. Players are presented with multiple options, some of which contain intentional flaws. By exploring these alternatives and experiencing their outcomes, players develop a deeper understanding of why certain decisions are more effective than others. This approach fosters curiosity, critical thinking, and active learning.

The project was designed to be interactive, accessible, and educational, while remaining a fun and engaging experience. Through gameplay, participants gain knowledge about the Artemis II mission, spacecraft construction, mission objectives, planning strategies, engineering constraints, and the various stages that comprise real-world space exploration. The game also introduces key concepts such as material selection, weight limitations, costs, budgeting, and the pros and cons of various design solutions—particularly during the spacecraft construction phase.

Developed using tools like Google AI Studio, GitHub, and Render, the project incorporates modern web technologies, including HTML5, CSS3, Three.js, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, and GLSL. These resources enable the creation of a visually rich, interactive environment that fosters both learning and engagement.

The project’s core objective is to inspire people from diverse regions and backgrounds, making space exploration more accessible and understandable. By allowing players to take an active role in the planning and execution of a space mission, the game offers a unique behind-the-scenes perspective—revealing the challenges of crewed spaceflight—while simultaneously promoting scientific knowledge in an engaging, enjoyable, and memorable way.
